name: Endless Shadow
descriptionTemplate: Temporarily reduce all enemies' {STR▼} by [Exhaustion:Arg1]. Gain [Power:Arg2] {STR▼}. Take effect X additional times (X ≤ 5).
lore:
During routine inspections at Mythag, researchers conducted a dedicated study of this amorphous, pitch-black mass.
To their surprise, they did manage to extract certain material components. Then they rushed to conduct a second experiment, only to obtain entirely different results.
As if mirroring its amorphous nature, its composition shifts with every passing moment, like an elusive phantom.
For the formless, its root is naught but formlessness.
